name: Abbasid Revolution Originates in Khorasan
summary: The Abbasid Revolution of 750 CE originated in Khorasan, where discontent with Umayyad Arab supremacism was strongest. The predominantly Iranian and Muslim soldiers of Khorasan formed the military backbone of the Abbasid victory, and Khorasan's cultural traditions profoundly shaped the cosmopolitan Abbasid caliphate.
